name: Aloo Achari Paratha
ingredients_raw: Potatoes (40%), Whole Wheat Flour (38%), Refined Sunflower Oil, Mix Pickle - (8%) (Raw Mango, Lime, Chillies, Ginger, Carrots, Salt, Vegetable Oil, Ground & Whole Spices (Fenugreek, Mustard Seeds, Turmeric, Chilli, Fennel, Nigella Seeds and Coriander), Asafoetida & Acidity Regulator (E260)), Water, Salt, Coriander Leaves, Fennel, Red Chilli, Coriander Seeds, Cumin and Mustard.
